title: Current through resistor
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the current through the fixed resistor using Ohm's law with the voltage across it.

title: Motor input power
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the total power consumed by the motor using the voltmeter reading and the circuit current.

title: Motor output power
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the mechanical output power by subtracting the coil's thermal power from the total input power.

title: Voltage distribution reasoning
description: Important: Recognizes the series circuit and correctly finds the voltage across the fixed resistor from the source and motor voltages.

title: Motor coil heating power
description: Important: Calculates the power dissipated as heat in the motor's coil using its resistance and the circuit current.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Includes correct units (A, V, W, Ω) in all intermediate and final answers.

title: Incorrect voltage assignment
description: Pitfall: Misinterprets the voltmeter reading as the voltage across the resistor or the full source voltage.

title: Power formula confusion
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect formula (e.g., V²/R or I²R) with wrong voltages/currents to find motor input or output power.
